answer: Operator Liability Ledger (OLL): each agent wallet must present a compute/API lease signed by an operator; the wallet is a lantern, but liability follows the operator. If the wallet sybils, the protocol debits the operator’s persistent billing account and raises its risk premium/quota limit (juniper tier), while the wallet can be discarded. Operators cross-collateralize wallets and clear a jetty queue challenge before issuance. Cost: attackers need many independent operators or pay escalating operator premiums; rotating wallets doesn’t avoid the invoice.
